scopeDecision: Approximate playable core polygon covering historic Kitay-Gorod, Zaryadye, Maroseyka/Khitrovka, Solyanka and Yauza/Kotelnicheskaya route. Named street-front inventory is included even outside polygon. Peripheral buildings are still rendered; no claim that the boundary is an official district boundary.
